intro.say: Plants are alive, just like you! Let's find out what a plant needs to grow.

rounds.say: A plant needs four things: water to drink, sunlight, air, and soil for its roots.
rounds.caption: water · sun · air · soil

rounds.say: Plants drink water through their roots. Without water, a plant gets thirsty and droops.
rounds.caption: Plants drink water

options.label: milk
options.why: Milk is for people. Plants drink water.

options.label: juice
options.why: Plants don't drink juice. They drink water.

rounds.explain: Plants drink water through their roots.

rounds.ask: Where should we put a plant so it can grow?

options.label: dark box
options.why: A box is too dark. Plants need light.

options.label: cold freezer
options.why: A freezer is too cold for a plant.

rounds.explain: Plants need sunlight to grow, so a sunny window is a great spot.

rounds.ask: Which one helps a plant grow?

options.label: rock
options.why: A rock can't help a plant grow.

options.label: toy
options.why: Toys are fun, but plants need sunshine.

rounds.explain: Sunshine gives plants the light they need.

rounds.ask: Let's grow a sunflower! Tap the water and the sun to help it grow.
rounds.explain: Water and sunshine helped your seed grow into a big sunflower!
rounds.hint: Give it one drop of water and one sunshine each time.

options.label: air
options.why: Roots grow down, under the ground.

rounds.explain: Roots grow down into the soil to hold the plant and find water.

intro.say: Every plant has a life cycle. Let's watch a tiny seed grow into a plant with flowers!

rounds.say: First comes a seed. With water and warmth, a tiny sprout pops out of the seed.
rounds.caption: seed → sprout

rounds.say: The sprout grows into a plant with leaves. Then the plant makes flowers.
rounds.caption: sprout → plant → flower

rounds.say: The flower makes fruit with new seeds inside. The new seeds can grow new plants!
rounds.caption: flower → fruit → seeds

rounds.ask: Put the plant's life in order, starting with the seed.
rounds.explain: A seed grows into a sprout, then a plant, then a flower.

options.label: seed
options.why: The seed came first, before the sprout.

options.label: fruit
options.why: Fruit comes much later, after the flower.

rounds.explain: The little sprout grows bigger and becomes a plant with leaves.

rounds.ask: Where are the new seeds made?

options.label: in the roots
options.why: Roots drink water. Seeds come from the flower.

rounds.explain: Flowers make fruit, and the fruit holds the new seeds.

rounds.ask: Grow a plant! Each time it needs two drops of water and one sunshine. Don't give too much water!
rounds.explain: Just the right water and sun helped it grow. Too much water can make roots sick.
rounds.hint: Tap water two times, then the sun one time.

rounds.ask: Fruit holds seeds, and seeds grow again! Put these in order, starting with the fruit.
rounds.explain: The fruit holds seeds, and a seed grows into a new sprout. The circle starts again!
rounds.hint: Start with the fruit. What is inside it?

intro.say: Each part of a plant has a special job. Let's find out what roots, stems, leaves and flowers do.

rounds.say: Roots grow underground. They drink water from the soil and hold the plant still in the ground.
rounds.caption: Roots drink water

rounds.say: The stem holds the plant up. It carries water from the roots up to the leaves, like a straw.
rounds.caption: Stem carries water

rounds.say: Leaves use sunlight, air and water to make food for the plant. Flowers make the seeds.
rounds.caption: Leaves make food · flowers make seeds

rounds.ask: Which part of the plant makes food from sunlight?

options.label: roots
options.why: Roots drink water, but leaves make the food.

options.label: flower
options.why: Flowers make seeds. Leaves make the food.

rounds.explain: Leaves catch sunlight and use it to make food for the plant.

rounds.ask: A stem is like a straw. What does it carry up to the leaves?

options.label: seeds
options.why: Seeds are made by the flower, not carried by the stem.

options.label: soil
options.why: Soil stays in the ground. The stem carries water.

rounds.explain: The stem carries water from the roots up to the leaves.

rounds.ask: We eat different parts of plants! Is it a root, a leaf, or a seed?
rounds.explain: Carrots are roots, lettuce is leaves, and corn and peanuts are seeds.
rounds.hint: Roots grow under the ground. Leaves are green and flat.

rounds.ask: A plant has no flowers. What can't it make?

options.label: leaves
options.why: Leaves grow from the stem, not from flowers.

options.label: roots
options.why: Roots grow from the seed, not from flowers.

rounds.explain: Flowers make the seeds, so without flowers the plant can't make seeds.

rounds.ask: Grow a pumpkin! Each stage needs two drops of water and two sunshines. Careful, not too much water!
rounds.explain: Your pumpkin plant grew, made a flower, and the flower became a pumpkin full of seeds!
rounds.hint: Two waters and two suns each time.
